# TASK-149 — specification

## Scope

NVIDIA NIM provider: connect the free hosted NVIDIA endpoint (`https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1`, key from build.nvidia.com) as an AI provider for proposals, imports and the Build with AI conversation; a self-hosted NIM works through `NIM_BASE_URL` without a key. The key is encrypted and write-only; local-only projects never use NIM; the model list shows chat models only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Add `nvidia-nim` beside OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama and Claude Agent.
- [x] It speaks the OpenAI chat protocol, so proposals (`generate`), model listing and the streaming tool-calling conversation reuse one OpenAI-compatible path with a different base URL and key.
- [x] Default host is the free hosted API Catalog; `NIM_BASE_URL` points at a self-hosted NIM (no key needed, URL checked, no embedded credentials).
- [x] The key is stored like the other provider keys (encrypted, write-only, never returned or logged).
- [x] NIM is a network provider: local-only projects keep refusing everything except Ollama, even when NIM is self-hosted (private-network NIM for local-only projects is backlog).
- [x] Hosted free-tier rate limits (429) are retryable.

## Verification

- tests/nim.test.ts
- integrations.test.tsx

## Notes

One OpenAI-compatible path shared with OpenAI (`openaiHost`, `openaiTurn`); address rules and model filter in `nim.ts`. Tests: `tests/nim.test.ts` (fake OpenAI-compatible server), `integrations.test.tsx`. Verified: the hosted model list's public shape, the Settings card in the browser.
